title: R8 two-letter kernels: comparison of engine A and engine B

resolved_disagreements.symptom: 188/389 W0 rows disagree with the identity map
resolved_disagreements.resolution: engine A direction M (= realisation D index M, two-component m = M+1) <-> engine B index D2B[M], D2B = (1,2,3,0) on V (check_dictionary.py B1); engine B A_0 is the sigma = 1 direction (m = 4)

resolved_disagreements.symptom: with the intertwiner of step2/notation/check_dictionary.py (A1-A3, rho_A|Sigma = s[M]) and the vector map M -> M: 144/389 W0 rows disagree
resolved_disagreements.resolution: engine A vertices use rho|Sigma = sb[M] (r2_core Yukawa lambda^T sb[M] lambda A_M, ea_core G5S); sb[9] = -s[9], s[M] = sb[M] for M <= 8.  The same (U, U*) intertwines engine A with D after e_9 -> -e_9: A^(A)_9 = -A^(D)_{I=6}.  With this map all rows agree.  Consequence for the notation layer: translating engine-A components into two-component form with U requires the e_9 flip (the A1 statement "vector map M -> M" holds for rho|Sigma = s, not for engine A's kernels)

resolved_disagreements.symptom: 30/389 rows (two or more odd outputs, e.g. c|c -> c c: A +2, B -2) disagree without a Koszul sign
resolved_disagreements.resolution: engine A orders the odd output parameters along the chain from letter a (Y_1, ..., Y_k); engine B in increasing label order; value_A = sgn(permutation of the odd labels) value_B.  Both are internally consistent (both pass W1 for c)

resolved_disagreements.what: odd-pair Hessian sign (engine B ODD_M_SIGN = +1 set empirically; engine A (-1)^{|X_a|+|X_b|} derived)
resolved_disagreements.symptom: none: every odd-pair entry (AV|lamP, AV|lamM, AV|c, AV|AsV, AW|lamP, AW|lamM, AW|c, AW|AsV, lamP|AsV, lamM|AsV) agrees
resolved_disagreements.resolution: the two prescriptions coincide; engine A supplies the derivation (d_j d_l (delta M) = (-1)^{|M|(|j|+|l|)} delta d_j d_l M), W1 fixes it independently in both engines

resolved_disagreements.symptom: 5 rows of 164 disagreed in a first pass
resolved_disagreements.resolution: all at a sampled zero derivative direction: the empty letter polynomial is read by ea_kern.kernel as "no factor" (fa or 1).  Directions resampled nonzero: 164/164 agree

resolved_disagreements.what: comparator artefact, sign of R in eq:tl-bubbleclosed
resolved_disagreements.symptom: first pass used R = -(sum of output momenta)
resolved_disagreements.resolution: theory: iR = d on the product of the outputs, i.e. R = p_a + p_b = sum of output momenta (the operator insertion is local, the letter momenta flowing into it add up to the output momenta); with it 1350/1350 checks agree

identical outputs: the factor converting the labelled multilinear form to a functional is 1/prod_t(n_t!) (n_t outputs of type t), not 1/2 in general; engine B used it only for two identical outputs (spectra unaffected)
two_site.json D1_eigenvalues strings "x - (1/3+theta) v." lack the unit u and abbreviate the classical dilatation
P6b holds at matrix level for twist two (two sites, N <= 8): in the letter basis D^kZ/k! the ZZ part of lc^natural on tr(D^aZ D^bZ) equals -2(H'_12 + H'_21) u, H'_12 of B03c (3.14)
